content.text:
The "All products" and "Bundles" headings on the products page are now in capitals, 16px, with letters spaced 0.08em apart.

The change is a new rule in the Products section of `site/css/pages.css`. It only applies to `.page-products .section-title`, because the other pages use the same `.section-title` class and shouldn't change.

I checked it in the browser. At desktop and mobile widths, both headings show as "ALL PRODUCTS" and "BUNDLES" at 16px with 1.28px letter spacing, which is 0.08em. The home page headings are unchanged (24px, or 21px on mobile). All 16 functional tests pass.

Separately, `git status` shows untracked `.idea/` and `.vscode/` folders. They're editor settings folders, and I left them alone.

STATUS: DONE
